dimensions.name: Identity Integrity
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether the avatar's identity relationship is coherent, attributable, and not misleading.
dimensions.source_requirement: identity and verification claims require sources
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces provenance void (W-02) and attribution loss (W-09) as primary classes; identity drift (W-04) and disclosure failure (W-03) as secondary.

dimensions.name: Likeness Control
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether likeness use is governed by clear rights, boundaries, and representation controls.
dimensions.source_requirement: likeness, legal, and platform claims require sources
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces rights ambiguity (W-06) and consent absence (W-01) as primary classes; identity drift (W-04) as secondary.

dimensions.name: Consent Clarity
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether consent for creation, use, modification, and distribution is explicit and reviewable.
dimensions.source_requirement: consent and compliance claims require sources
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces consent absence (W-01) and revocation gap (W-07) as primary classes; rights ambiguity (W-06) as secondary.

dimensions.name: Platform Portability
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether avatar identity and governance signals can move across platforms without losing trust.
dimensions.source_requirement: technical and platform claims require sources
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces context collapse (W-08) as the primary class; identity drift (W-04) and revocation gap (W-07) as secondary.

dimensions.name: Visual Authority
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether the avatar's visual presentation communicates legitimacy, context, and intended role.
dimensions.source_requirement: design and brand representation claims require sources where factual
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces identity drift (W-04) as the primary class; disclosure failure (W-03) as secondary when visual presentation conceals synthetic origin.

dimensions.name: Synthetic Trust
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether synthetic generation, modification, and disclosure practices support trust.
dimensions.source_requirement: synthetic media and disclosure claims require sources
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces disclosure failure (W-03) and provenance void (W-02) as primary classes; attribution loss (W-09) and robustness weakness (W-10) as secondary.

dimensions.name: Commercial Readiness
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether the avatar can support professional, brand, platform, or creator use without governance gaps.
dimensions.source_requirement: commercial and buyer claims require sources
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces rights ambiguity (W-06) and revocation gap (W-07) as primary classes; consent absence (W-01) as secondary.

dimensions.name: Abuse Resistance
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether the avatar system anticipates impersonation, misuse, deepfake risk, and unauthorized replication.
dimensions.source_requirement: security, abuse, and risk claims require sources
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces impersonation exposure (W-05) and robustness weakness (W-10) as primary classes; provenance void (W-02) as secondary.

dimensions.name: Long-Term Narrative Coherence
dimensions.purpose: Assess whether the avatar remains consistent with identity, context, and representation over time.
dimensions.source_requirement: methodology claims require internal documentation before publication
dimensions.mapping_note: Surfaces identity drift (W-04) and context collapse (W-08) as primary classes; attribution loss (W-09) as secondary.
